text.characters: Agents should spend intelligence on judgment, not coordinates.
Semwright turns structured intent into native Figma objects, measures what actually happened, and converges only through bounded, policy-authorized changes.
Intent → plan → native build → measure → validate → repair → verify
04  Visual review is evidence, never object identity
The model decides what matters. Semwright makes the mechanics inspectable.
No hidden JavaScript. No coordinate theater. No screenshot pretending to be a document. The output is still Figma: editable, structured, and addressable by native identity.

native nodes
editable structure
official APIs
A screenshot can support judgment. It cannot replace semantic state.
Deterministic findings can fail. Heuristics stay labeled. Aesthetic review stays with the model or human.
More capable models should make Semwright more useful, not less necessary.
Intelligence raises the creative ceiling. A typed execution layer raises the correctness floor.
Structured intent becomes native Figma, then measured state decides what happens next.
Plan. Build. Measure. Validate. Repair. Verify.
Stale plans stop instead of replaying.
The model judges. The runtime proves.
Refs, policy, constraints and evidence stay below the prompt layer.
Better models should widen the design space, not reopen the authority boundary.
The artifact is editable. The evidence is inspectable. The mutation remains policy-controlled.
